{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In mathematics, a '''Vogan diagram''', named after [[David Vogan]], is a variation of the [[Dynkin diagram]] of a real semisimple [[Lie algebra]] that indicates the maximal compact subgroup. Although they resemble [[Satake diagram]]s they are a different way of classifying simple Lie algebras.
